title: PLAIN LANGUAGE QUESTING SHOWCASE
description: The patch claims to simplify progression, then decides whose confusion counts as acceptable loss. Quest text now says what to do before explaining which ancient committee made it necessary. Boss intros and failure states now create cleaner moments for streams, trailers, and context-free yelling.
consequence: Players discovered the objective without consulting three tabs and a priest. Marketing finally found footage that did not require a glossary.

title: PLAIN LANGUAGE QUESTING FOUNDATION
description: The change decides which delays are atmosphere and which delays are invoices. Quest text now says what to do before explaining which ancient committee made it necessary. Several improvements focus on crash fixes, save safety, and boring reliability instead of visible beats.
consequence: Players discovered the objective without consulting three tabs and a priest. The game improved in ways that make terrible thumbnails.

title: MINIMAL GUIDANCE MODE SHOWCASE
description: The feature moves a player-facing convenience into the same room as a business goal. Several prompts have been removed so discovery can emerge naturally from confusion and patch forum archaeology. Boss intros and failure states now create cleaner moments for streams, trailers, and context-free yelling.
consequence: The tutorial got shorter. So did the time before players asked what was happening. Marketing finally found footage that did not require a glossary.
